[\"下载上方对应版本的 Windows 安装包，双击后选择安装目录，按需勾选桌.en: Download the corresponding version of the Windows installer above, double-click it, choose the installation directory, and check the desktop shortcut if needed. The installer contains the game files, so it can be operated offline during installation. The wizard will show the progress, and you can also cancel. For the portable version, please download the Windows ZIP from the [[O0]]release page[[C0]], fully extract it, and then open it.

[\"普通版双击 [[A0]]；图鉴版双击 [[A1]]。请保留整个文件夹，不要.en: For the Normal Edition, double-click [[A0]]; for the Gallery Edition, double-click [[A1]]. Keep the entire folder rather than copying only the EXE.

[\"窗口左下角“存档”可打开管理窗口并导出备份。要导入另一份进度，先关闭游戏，.en: The 'Save' button at the bottom left of the window can open the management window and export backups. To import another progress, first close the game, then double-click [[A0]] in the folder, and click 'Import Save'.

[\"存档位于程序旁的 [[A0]] 或 [[A1]]。覆盖升级请选择原来的安装.en: Save files are located next to the program at [[A0]] or [[A1]]. For an upgrade overwrite, choose the original installation directory. When changing directories or computers, export the save files first, then import them into the same version at the new location. After closing the game window, the local service will automatically exit.

[\"等待本地运行环境启动，选择“导入存档”，在系统文件选择器中选中 [[A0].en: Wait for the local runtime to start, choose "Import Save," and use the system file picker to select a [[A0]] file, a compatible JSON file, or a protocol JSONL file containing complete initialization data. If you have no backup, choose "Start a New Journey."

[\"在旧设备结束当前游戏画面，进入“存档”→“导出存档”，得到 [[A0]].en: End the current game screen on the old device, go to "Save" → "Export Save", and obtain the [[A0]] file.

[\"在新设备打开[[O0]]同一版本[[C0]]，点击“导入存档”。确认后进入.en: On the new device, open the [[O0]]same edition[[C0]] and choose "Import Save." After confirming, enter the game and check the frog's name, album, and items.

[\"已有本项目备份的玩家直接使用上方导入功能。还只有官服账号时，需要在[[O0.en: If you already have a backup from this project, use the import feature above. If you only have an official-server account, first capture the complete login initialization data on a device where [[O0]]you can still log in to the official game[[C0]]. The offline version does not ask for your phone number, verification code, or official-server password, and cannot recover progress from a closed server using account details alone.

[\"从 [[O0]]源码仓库[[C0]]下载源码 ZIP 并解压，在该目录打开.en: Download the source ZIP from the [[O0]]source repository[[C0]] and extract it, then open CMD in that directory. Install Python and Android Platform Tools so that the [[A1]] and [[A2]] commands are usable; when connecting multiple devices, add [[A4]] after [[A3]] for each ADB command.

[\"记下当前已运行版本的[[O0]]完整文件路径[[C0]]。如果有多个结果，.en: Record the running version's [[O0]]full file path[[C0]]. If several results appear, identify the resource version that most recently ran rather than choosing the first result at random. If this path does not exist, this guide does not apply to your client's structure.

[\"打开一个[[O0]]单独的 CMD 窗口[[C0]]开始记录，再启动官服应.en: Open a [[O0]]separate CMD window[[C0]] to start logging, then launch the official game:

[\"退出官服，在采集窗口按 [[A0]] 停止。回到源码目录的 CMD 执行：.en: Exit the official server, and in the collection window press [[A0]] to stop. Then return to the source directory and execute in CMD:

[\"查看输出的 [[A0]] 与 [[A1]]。分块缺失或 JSON 解析失败.en: Check the output of [[A0]] and [[A1]]. If chunks are missing or JSON parsing fails, recollect; if album details are missing, recollect the corresponding photos. If the log is not a complete login initialization, importing will prompt that necessary data is missing.

[\"将 [[A0]] 复制到目标设备，在[[O1]]普通版[[C1]]中“导入.en: Copy [[A0]] to the target device and select Import Save in the [[O1]]Normal Edition[[C1]]. After checking the frog, inventory, photos, and diary, export a [[A2]] backup for long-term storage.

[\"已验证 Windows、安卓模拟器及 Chromium / WebKit.en: Import/export on Windows, Android emulators, and Chromium/WebKit, as well as entering the game and offline recovery on web pages, have been verified. The specific systems, storage recovery, and long-term background behavior on physical phones still need real-device validation; regular exporting is recommended. If there are issues, please submit them to the [[O0]]project Issues[[C0]], specifying your device, version, and operations. Do not publicly upload the save files or original logs.
